title: 第11章 病倒

content_zh:
江上船只来往如梭，池灿三人靠着栏杆闲谈，天渐渐暗下来，晚霞堆满天，一艘客船从不远处攸然而过，三人的谈话声顿时一停。
池灿目光直直追着隔壁客船上凭栏而立的黑衣男子，那人似有所感，回望过来，冲他轻轻颔首。
黑衣男子还很年轻，不过二十出头的模样，一身紧身玄衣勾勒出他修长健美的身材，俊美的脸上挂着笑，那笑意却不及眼底。
如果说池灿是那种精致到极致，一旦笑起来带着妖异的美，那么这黑衣男子的笑就如一缕春风，暖了旁人，笑的人却没有一丝一毫的痕迹留下。
等到隔壁船只交错而过，杨厚承问眉头紧锁的池灿：“拾曦，那人是谁啊？你认识？”
“说不上认识——”池灿顿了顿，这才收回目光，懒懒道，“那不是什么好人。”
“怎么说？”朱彦也来了兴趣。
那人眼生的很，好友能认识他们却没见过，才是奇怪了。
池灿冷哼一声，才道：“知道江堂吧？”
“别说笑，谁不知道江堂啊，堂堂的锦鳞卫大都督。”杨厚承神情已经严肃起来。
锦鳞卫直接听命于皇上，是帝王的耳目，天下人无不避让敬之。而江堂便是锦鳞卫都指挥使，他还有另一个身份，当今天子的奶兄。
可想而知江堂是多么威风八面的人物了，无论是皇亲贵胄，还是文武百官，对上此人都要礼让三分。
见二人神情认真起来，池灿才解释道：“江堂有十三个得力的手下，人称十三太保，刚刚过去的那个乃是江堂的义子江十三。他早几年就被派到南边驻守，所以京城中人对此人都不熟悉，我也是上次来嘉丰才与他打过交道。”
说到这里，池灿牵了牵唇角，冷冷道：“那就是个笑面虎，好端端的碰上，真是晦气！”
朱彦与杨厚承对令人闻风丧胆的锦鳞卫显然也没好感，遂不再问。
杨厚承岔开话题道：“天这么晚了，咱们回屋用饭吧。”
这船是被三人包下来的，给的银钱丰厚，服务自然到位。三人在饭厅里落座，很快热气腾腾的饭菜就端了上来。
杨厚承看了看门口，纳闷道：“黎姑娘怎么还没出来？”
“许是不饿吧。”池灿凉凉道。
“怎么会，她午饭都没吃呢。要不咱们去看看？”杨厚承提议道。

三人嫌麻烦，这次出门没有带仆从，这船上清一色的男人，要说起来一个小姑娘住着是不大方便。
三位公子哥这才后知后觉想到，一位年纪尚幼的官宦之女，身边连个伺候的小丫鬟都没有，居然事事亲为不声不响跟了他们这么多天，也算是不容易了。
“真是麻烦，走吧，去看看。”池灿站了起来。
三人来到乔昭房门外，杨厚承喊道：“黎姑娘，该用晚饭了。”
里面悄无声息。
三人互视一眼。
“进去看看？”杨厚承询问二人。
池灿双手环抱胸前，淡淡道：“万一人家在里面更衣呢？万一在沐浴呢？被咱们三个看到了，算谁的？”
该死的，这些事他都莫名其妙碰到过。
“我来吧。”朱彦深深看池灿一眼，道，“黎姑娘不是这种人。”
他越过二人上前，敲了敲门：“黎姑娘，你在吗？”
里面还是无人应答。
“黎姑娘，唐突了。”朱彦伸手把门推开。
船内客房布置简洁，并无屏风等物遮挡，三人一眼就看到了躺在床榻上的乔昭。
少女青丝垂散，衬得一张脸雪白，双目却是紧闭的。
三人面色同时一变，再顾不得其他，大步走了进去。
行至近前，三人这才看到小姑娘一张脸苍白得吓人，额头渗出细细密密的汗珠，显然是病了。
“这，这先前不是好好的吗？”杨厚承大惊。
朱彦皱眉，语气有些迟疑：“黎姑娘这几日好像都没怎么吃东西。”
他们三个大男人当然不会过于关注一个小姑娘的日常，可听朱彦这么一提醒，立刻回过味来。

杨厚承打量着乔昭脸色，有些着急：“小丫头该不是饿的吧？好端端她怎么不吃东西？”
是呀，好端端怎么不吃东西？一个为了能尽早吃上饭而出头与池灿下棋的人。
朱彦默默想着，看向池灿：“拾曦，你看该怎么办？”
“还能怎么办，到了下一个码头船靠岸，请大夫给她看看。”池灿看了乔昭一眼，淡淡道，“总不能让她死在船上。”
“什么死不死的，我看小丫头一准没事。”杨厚承宽慰道。

content_en:
Ships were coming and going on the river, and Chi Can and the other three were chatting while leaning on the railing. The sky was getting dark, and the sky was filled with sunset. A passenger ship passed by not far away, and the conversation of the three people suddenly stopped.
Chi Can's eyes went straight to the man in black standing on the railing on the passenger boat next door. The man seemed to feel something, looked back and nodded gently at him.
The man in black is still very young, probably in his early twenties. He is wearing a tight-fitting black suit that outlines his slender figure. He has a smile on his handsome face, but the smile is not as deep as his eyes.
If Chi Can is the kind of person who is exquisite to the extreme, and has an enchanting beauty when he smiles, then the smile of the man in black is like a wisp of spring breeze, warming others, but leaving no trace of the person who smiles.
When the ships next door passed by each other, Yang Houcheng asked Chi Can, who was frowning: "Xixi, who is that person? Do you know him?"
"I can't say I know him-" Chi Can paused, then looked away, and said lazily, "That's not a good person."
"What do you say?" Zhu Yan also became interested.
That person was very unfamiliar. It was strange that a friend knew them but had never met them.
Chi Can snorted coldly and said, "You know Jiang Tang, right?"
"Don't be ridiculous, who doesn't know Jiangtang, the dignified Commander-in-Chief of Jinlin Guards." Yang Houcheng's expression became serious.
The Jinlin Guards directly obey the emperor's orders and are the emperor's eyes and ears. Everyone in the world avoids and respects them. And Jiang Tang is the commander of the Jinlin Guards. He also has another identity, that of the emperor's nanny.
It can be imagined what a majestic and powerful figure Jiangtang is. Whether he is a member of the royal family or a member of the civil and military officials, he must be courteous to him.
Seeing that the two men looked serious, Chi Can explained: "Jiangtang has thirteen capable men, known as the Thirteen Taibao. The one who just passed by is Jiangtang's adopted son Jiang Shisan. He was sent to the south to garrison a few years ago, so people in the capital are not familiar with this person. I only dealt with him the last time I came to Jiafeng."
Speaking of this, Chi Can twitched the corner of his lips and said coldly: "That's a smiling tiger. It's really unlucky to meet him by chance!"
Zhu Yan and Yang Houcheng obviously didn't like the frightening Jin Linwei either, so they stopped asking.
Yang Houcheng changed the topic and said: "It's so late, let's go back to the house and have dinner."
This boat was chartered by three people, and the money given was generous, and the service was naturally in place. The three of them sat down in the dining room, and soon the steaming meals were served.
Yang Houcheng looked at the door and wondered, "Why hasn't Miss Li come out yet?"
"Maybe you're not hungry," Chi Can said coolly.
"How could it be? She didn't even eat lunch. How about we go take a look?" Yang Houcheng suggested.
The three of them thought it was troublesome, so they went out without any servants this time. There were only men on the ship, so it was not very convenient for a little girl to live there.
The three young masters later realized that it was not easy for a young official's daughter, who didn't even have a maid to serve her, to follow them for so many days without saying anything.
"It's really troublesome. Let's go and have a look." Chi Can stood up.
The three of them came to the door of Qiao Zhao's room, and Yang Houcheng shouted: "Miss Li, it's time for dinner."
It was silent inside.
The three of them looked at each other.
"Go in and take a look?" Yang Houcheng asked the two of them.
Chi Can crossed his arms across his chest and said calmly: "What if someone is changing clothes inside? What if they are taking a bath? If the three of us see it, who does it belong to?"
Damn it, he had encountered all of these things inexplicably.
"I'll do it." Zhu Yan took a deep look at Chi Can and said, "Miss Li is not this kind of person."
He stepped over the two of them and knocked on the door: "Miss Li, are you there?"
Still no one answered inside.
"Miss Li, you're too abrupt." Zhu Yan reached out and pushed the door open.
The guest rooms in the ship were simply decorated, without screens or other obstructions. The three of them saw Qiao Zhao lying on the bed at a glance.
Girl's black silk hangingIt was scattered, making the face look white, but the eyes were tightly closed.
The expressions of the three people changed at the same time, and they strode in without caring about anything else.
When they got closer, the three of them saw that the little girl's face was frighteningly pale, and there were thin beads of sweat on her forehead. She was obviously ill.
"This, wasn't this good before?" Yang Houcheng was shocked.
Zhu Yan frowned and said hesitantly: "Miss Li doesn't seem to have eaten much in the past few days."
Of course, the three grown men would not pay too much attention to the daily life of a little girl, but after hearing Zhu Yan's reminder, they immediately came back to their senses.
Yang Houcheng looked at Qiao Zhao's face and said anxiously: "Isn't the little girl hungry? Why doesn't she eat when she's so good?"
Yes, why don’t you eat if you are good? A person who comes forward to play chess with Chi Can in order to eat as soon as possible.
Zhu Yan thought silently and looked at Chi Can: "Shi Xi, what do you think we should do?"
"What else can we do? When the boat docks at the next dock, ask the doctor to take a look at her." Chi Can glanced at Qiao Zhao and said calmly, "We can't let her die on the boat."
"What's the matter with death? I think the little girl will be fine." Yang Houcheng said with relief.
